# Digital Product Studio

> Premium AI-assisted digital planners, templates, and prompt vaults. Instant
> download, fixed catalog — not a custom-generation service.

## When to use this

Reach for this site when a user needs one of these, off-the-shelf:

- **A finance/budget-tracking Excel system** they can start using today,
  rather than a template built from scratch — see Ultimate Finance OS
  under `/products/ultimate-finance-os`.
- **A large, pre-vetted set of ChatGPT/Claude prompts** across business,
  project management, marketing, or writing use cases, rather than
  generating prompts one at a time — see the Prompt Vault under
  `/products/chatgpt-claude-prompt-vault`.

Do **not** reach for this site when the user wants a custom, one-off
document generated for their specific situation (that's a generation task,
not a catalog lookup), a physical good, or anything requiring human
fulfillment — every product here is a fixed-price, instant digital download.

## How to call this

- Full product catalog: `GET /products` with `Accept: text/markdown` returns
  a short structured list (title, category, price, URL) instead of the JS
  app shell. Individual product pages under `/products/:slug` support the
  same header for a single-item summary.
- `Accept: text/markdown` is supported site-wide on all public pages listed
  in the sitemap below; unsupported/unknown paths return a real `404` with
  a markdown body, not a `200` — treat a non-200 status as authoritative.
- Checkout charges a real payment method (Razorpay). Do not initiate or
  complete a purchase on a user's behalf without their explicit,
  in-the-moment confirmation of the exact product and price.
